resource_measurement_scope: RSS/cgroup peaks sampled sequentially by service; combined peak is not atomic. CPU covers the first-to-last retained counter probes. Profiling resources use only complete probes within the stable observed stage window. Spill counts directories touched since this cycle; no lifetime memory peak is used as a phase peak.
chain_phase_resource_scope: Independent phase samplers retain RSS/cgroup, CPU counters, shared temporary storage, and host disk free. Per-phase spill was not retained by this sampler; the separate integral and acquisition-stage samplers retain spill. A one-sample phase has no measured CPU or memory-event delta. Shared filesystem byte observations are maxima across services, never summed.
warmth_scope: Repeated fixture bytes on the same private host after previous certification; no cold-cache capacity claim.
